about.title: What is Warhounds?
paragraphs: Warhounds is a turn-based tactical strategy game developed by Everplay DMCC and published by Brightika, Inc. In a 2035 East African conflict, you command a private military company through field operations and a connected strategic layer.

The official material highlights five classes, veterans and recruits, destructible battlefields, true ballistics, tactical tools, base management, factions, intelligence, covert operations, and choices that can change missions, equipment, and support.
